[**![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1070751/description_f80168f8-5c01-42cf-a924-b36e91cafca5.png)**](https://modrinth.com/mod/wayfinder)

[**![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1070751/description_7acdccbe-8e6f-49f6-bde2-ee820d4370a9.png)**](https://modrinth.com/mod/nether-descent)

** **![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1070751/description_10da38ee-7e1c-4d1d-9bf5-d07267b232ad.png)** **「Oh The Biomes We've Gone」是經典模組「Oh The Biomes You'll Go」的續作，支援 1.20.1 及以上版本，新增超過 50 種令人驚嘆的魔幻與寫實生態域。BWG 將帶你展開一場冒險，為 Minecraft 注入豐富多樣且細緻的生命力。此外，BWG 還新增了獨特的生物、結構以及數百種可使用的方塊。** **![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_43d7961e-7fe6-4cab-9073-f96e1a05c5bf.png)**
